scope: Exactly 214 realized non-base equal-empty last-collector trades in all 1528 completed, numerically scored matches through aca9b8a3. Predict P(the opponent has no collector in every state t+1..t+30 | the trade occurs, observable information through t).
selector: Frozen frequency_games.jsonl.gz. Input features can use only the acting physical seat's observations at t-10..t, centering on t, plus public configuration; exclude terrain seed, registration, outcome, chosen commands, future facts and actual hunter identity.
split: Maps with any target registration whose SHA256(recovery-rival-v1|name) mod 5 equals 0 are reserved for testing. From all remaining maps, SHA256(recovery-map-v1|terrain-sha256) mod 5 equals 1 is also test. All others train. No selection by scores, labels or feature values. Mark all held-out rows by actual opponent-name presence in training.
training: Per-map mean loss. Main model is convex logistic regression on the fixed state features in head.py, train-mean centering and SD scaling, clipped at +3/-3 after scaling, intercept unregularized, penalty 0.08/2 times squared standardized coefficients. Control uses the same estimator with just tree-any and recruit shortfall. Also report training-prevalence baseline and four training-only cells (any tree; shortfall > half the fee), shrunk with four pseudo-observations at training prevalence.
censor: T-t <30 stays in audit ledger, omitted from training and all metrics; no post-end imputation.
assessment: Report map-equal Brier, natural log loss, reliability intervals [0,.2,.4,.6,.8,1], reliability gap, seat, win/draw/loss, name unseen in training and large individual errors. Paired resampling by independent test map, 2000 draws, seed 550099. No hyperparameter selection, retries or final formal-map use. Descriptive cohort-level results were already seen in prior work.
